title: Server export batch envelope
description: Authenticated batch identity carried outside the OTLP span payload. On the wire each member is one request header named `x-utrace-<member>` with `_` replaced by `-`; the bearer credential travels in the standard Authorization header. Retries preserve the batch_id, sequence, and span identities so ingestion can deduplicate.

batch_id.description: Immutable identity of this batch. A retry of the same batch reuses it.

batch_sequence.description: Stream-scoped, gapless, strictly increasing sequence starting at 1.

content_sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the uncompressed OTLP protobuf body. Ingestion uses it to acknowledge an exact duplicate without creating new evidence.
